item.title: ChatGPT for iOS
item.content:encoded:
# ChatGPT for iOS
### New features
- Add, preview, and remove attachments without leaving the full-screen composer. - Task read status now syncs with supported hosts, helping clear stale unread indicators across devices.
### Improvements and bug fixes
- Follow-ups steer the running task by default unless you have saved a different preference. - Improved response annotations: add and edit notes on selected text, and tap numbered references to revisit the selected text and its note. - Custom-provider tasks keep their model and reasoning effort when you send a follow-up from iOS. - When you reopen a task, prompts that failed to send retain their attachments, and you can retry sending them. - Improved keyboard behavior when opening tasks, scrolling long drafts, and returning to an open editor. - Drafts, text selection, and undo history survive changes between compact and split layouts. - Improved iPhone Duo layouts, including full-width editing and controls that stay above the keyboard. - Linked files open directly, and closing the preview takes you back to the task. Absolute file links outside the workspace also open correctly. - Images with relative file paths load from the directory where the original turn ran. - Fixed invisible chart labels and bars in inline visualizations. - Reconnect errors show a single Retry control, with better alignment on iPad. - Archiving a task can reconnect to its host when the computer appears offline.
